newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Yen recovery, weak Nikkei lift SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs.
newsitem.headline: Yen recovery, weak Nikkei lift SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs.

text.p: The yen's recovery against the dollar lifted SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures in late Tuesday trade and dealers said both ends of the yield curve showed slightly more upside potential.

The yen traded below 116 to the dollar for much of the day after a series of comments by Japanese government officials calling for greater stability in forex rates brought the dollar off a 46-month high of 117 yen seen early on Monday.
A 549-point drop in the 225-share Nikkei average also underpinned Euroyen and JGB futures on the perception Japan would need to maintain its low interest rate regime to bolster its flagging economy.
September Euroyen was quoted at 99.27 at 1130 GMT against its IMM close at 99.19. Volume was a moderate 14,820 lots.
March JGBs finished at 124.36 against their previous 123.73.
A Japanese bank dealer said 99.32 represented a crucial resistance level for September Euroyen.

Eurodollar futures ended little changed in thin trade as players continued their vigil for the U.S. December Producer Price Index and non-farm payrolls report, due later in the week. "It's quiet but the underlying tone is negative. There's talk that the payrolls data are quite strong," said a trader with a U.S. institution.
He said the U.S. short-term interest rate futures showed room to shed 10-15 ticks over the next month.
June Eurodollars closed unchanged from their IMM levels at 94.20.
